parts.name: stations
parts.sql:
CREATE TABLE stations(
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, lat REAL, lon REAL,
      opened TEXT, notes TEXT, photo BLOB)

parts.name: readings
parts.sql:
CREATE TABLE readings(
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      station_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES stations(id),
      at TEXT NOT NULL, height_m REAL,
      quality TEXT CHECK (quality IN ('good','suspect','missing')))

parts.name: surveys
parts.sql:
CREATE TABLE surveys(
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT, run_on TEXT, by TEXT, raw BLOB)

parts.name: tide_constants
parts.sql:
CREATE TABLE tide_constants(
      station_id INTEGER, constituent TEXT, amplitude REAL, phase REAL,
      PRIMARY KEY (station_id, constituent)) WITHOUT ROWID

parts.name: daily_high
parts.sql:
CREATE VIEW daily_high AS
      SELECT s.name AS station, substr(r.at,1,10) AS day, max(r.height_m) AS high_m
      FROM readings r JOIN stations s ON s.id = r.station_id
      GROUP BY r.station_id, day

parts.name: suspect_readings
parts.sql: CREATE VIEW suspect_readings AS SELECT * FROM readings WHERE quality = 'suspect'

schema.name: stations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE stations(
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, lat REAL, lon REAL,
      opened TEXT, notes TEXT, photo BLOB)

schema.name: readings
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE readings(
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      station_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES stations(id),
      at TEXT NOT NULL, height_m REAL,
      quality TEXT CHECK (quality IN ('good','suspect','missing')))

schema.name: surveys
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE surveys(
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT, run_on TEXT, by TEXT, raw BLOB)

schema.name: tide_constants
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE tide_constants(
      station_id INTEGER, constituent TEXT, amplitude REAL, phase REAL,
      PRIMARY KEY (station_id, constituent)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: idx_readings_station
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_readings_station ON readings(station_id, at)

schema.name: daily_high
schema.sql:
CREATE VIEW daily_high AS
      SELECT s.name AS station, substr(r.at,1,10) AS day, max(r.height_m) AS high_m
      FROM readings r JOIN stations s ON s.id = r.station_id
      GROUP BY r.station_id, day

schema.name: suspect_readings
schema.sql: CREATE VIEW suspect_readings AS SELECT * FROM readings WHERE quality = 'suspect'

schema.name: readings_range
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER readings_range BEFORE INSERT ON readings WHEN NEW.height_m > 12
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'height out of range'); END
